    BrickAccessibility.exists_string_quotient

    Lemma 5.3 (Wald–Waschbüsch): the string quotient of a special biserial algebra #

    For a special biserial algebra there is a two-sided ideal J (the sum of the socles of the nonuniserial projective-injective summands) such that A ⧸ J is a string algebra and every indecomposable module not killed by J is projective.

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.exists_string_quotient {k : Type u} [Field k] {A : Type u} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [IsAlgClosed k] [FiniteDimensional k A] {Q : Statement.FinQuiver} (D : PathData Q A) (hspan : Submodule.span k (Set.range fun (p : Q.V × List Q.A) => D.pval p.1 p.2) = ⊤) (hadm : D.IsAdmissible) (hsb : D.IsSpecialBiserial) :
    ∃ (J : Ideal A) (x : J.IsTwoSided) (D' : MonomialData k (A ⧸ J)), D'.IsStringAlgebra ∧ ∀ (M : Type u) [inst : AddCommGroup M] [inst_1 : Module A M] [inst_2 : Module k M] [IsScalarTower k A M] [FiniteDimensional k M], Statement.IsIndecomposable A M → ¬Module.IsTorsionBySet A M ↑J → Module.Projective A M
